usedFor: Heartbeat holds community members, and viaSocket utilities pauses the workflow after a “New User” joins, through “Pause Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Heartbeat, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: Waiting after someone joins lets you space the next step by a set number of minutes.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” only waits, so add the real action after it or nothing reaches your community.
